$comment: Reader suggestions published on the page.
FLOW: anyone submits via the form (no login). Submissions land in a Sheet. A human moves an
entry here to publish it. That one step between submission and publication is the whole design -
see content/13-suggestions.md for why an unmoderated stream was not the right answer for THIS
document.
FIELDS
date       YYYY-MM-DD, when the suggestion was received
from       display name the submitter gave, or null for anonymous. NEVER an email or phone.
org        their organisation, if given. Optional.
section    which section it concerns, e.g. '08'. Optional.
text       the suggestion, as submitted. Lightly edited for length only, never for meaning.
status     'new' | 'verified' | 'incorporated' | 'disputed'
response   the editor's note back, or null. Shown beneath the suggestion.
STATUS MEANINGS, and they are shown to the reader:
new          published as received; NOT checked by the editor
verified     the editor checked it against a source and it holds
incorporated the document text has been updated to reflect it
disputed     published, but the editor could not confirm it or found contrary evidence
NEVER publish a submitter's contact details here, even if they put them in the message body.
Strip them. The form collects contact separately and it does not belong on a public page.
